'''Kreen''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant Colonel/Legends|Lieutenant Colonel]] and [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of engineer [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] in the [[Praesitlyn Defense Force]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. While the [[Republic Army]] stationed on [[Praesitlyn/Legends|Praesitlyn]] [[Battle of Praesitlyn|fought]] the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] which had invaded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], Kreen was killed during in action.
